title: 🚨 YOUR PHONE ISN'T THE PROBLEM.
paragraphs: 🚨 YOUR PHONE ISN'T THE PROBLEM.
The problem is what it's discipling you into.
Every day, millions of Christians spend hours scrolling...
Yet struggle to spend 10 minutes in prayer.

We know every trend.
Every controversy.
Every viral video.
But many believers can't remember the last Bible verse they meditated on.
That should concern us.
HOW TO FOLLOW JESUS IN THE AGE OF SOCIAL MEDIA
This is not another book about deleting your apps.
It's about reclaiming your attention.
Because your attention shapes your desires.
Your desires shape your habits.
And your habits shape your future.
The world is fighting for your eyes, your mind, and your heart.
🔥 INSIDE YOU'LL DISCOVER:
✅ How social media silently shapes your thinking
✅ The hidden danger of comparison and digital distraction
✅ Why many Christians feel spiritually dry despite consuming more content than ever
✅ Biblical habits that strengthen your faith in a distracted world
✅ How to use social media for God's glory instead of being controlled by it
✅ Practical strategies to put Jesus first every day
✅ How to live for God's approval instead of people's opinions
⚔️ THE REALITY
Most people scroll until they feel empty.
Few people seek God until they are transformed.
Most people chase followers.
Few people follow Jesus.
Most people consume content.
Few people become disciples.
Most people want spiritual growth.
Few people are willing to guard their attention.
Which one are you?
🔥 THIS IS BIGGER THAN A BOOK
This is a movement of believers choosing Christ over distraction.
A movement of Christians refusing to let algorithms disciple them.
A movement of people who want to honor God with their time, attention, and lives.
🎁 FREE downloads added regularly
If you're tired of distractions stealing your focus...
If you're ready to stop being discipled by the culture...
If you're ready to follow Jesus with greater intentionality...
Become the kind of believer who follows Christ even when the world is pulling in the opposite direction.
